effect: The Stage 2A launcher re-verifies every pinned execution file and therefore refuses to run with this file changed (fail-closed by design). scripts/validation/verify_stage2a_provenance.py applies the administrative revisions in order and accepts only these recorded, Git-recoverable changes.
reason: Opt-in exact-restart contract for generations shorter than an epoch (scripts/training/optimizer_contract.py, data_cursor.py, weaver_full_state.py). The new shared keys optimizer_state_contract, generations_per_epoch and batches_per_generation, and the cadenced option lr_mutation_interval_generations, default to None; without them commands, seeds, resolved configurations, fingerprints and policy decisions are unchanged (tests/test_sub_epoch_generations.py; replay of the completed cadenced runs). make_command gains the entry point and cursor arguments and generation_seed. The Stage 2A protocol, inputs, checkpoints, inference and results are unchanged.
